ideas.title: Uncovering the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigating the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the $11 million case and potential connections to other schemes.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore international connections
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Are there other cases similar to the $11 million scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger pattern of fraud and abuse in Minnesota's Medicaid system, potentially leading to significant recoveries and reforms.
